events.text: The automobile tunnel on Budapester Straße in front of the Bikini-Haus was closed and the pedestrian zone extended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 2006 , the automobile tunnel on Budapester Straße in front of the Bikini-Haus was closed

events.text: The Bikinihaus began being refurbished as a shopping mall and a hotel.
events.subject: self
events.quote: From 2010 to 2014 the Bikinihaus was refurbished as a shopping mall and a hotel

events.text: The refurbishment of the Bikinihaus as a shopping mall and a hotel ended.

events.text: The destruction of the Schimmelpfeng-Haus began to build the Zoofenster highrise.

events.text: A truck-ramming attack was carried out on the Christmas market at Breitscheidplatz, killing twelve people and injuring 48 others.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 19 December 2016 , at about 20:00 local time , a truck-ramming attack was carried out on the Christmas market at Breitscheidplatz

events.text: In preparation for the Christmas market 2018, the square and its surrounding were fortified against further terrorist attacks.
